description: This header file declares utility functions within the Utils namespace for synchronizing file contents to disk and persisting JSON settings to a file. It includes functions for syncing file persistence and updating JSON configuration stored in files.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the specified file to disk by flushing buffers and calling fsync.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON setting to a file by reading, updating, and writing the JSON object, then ensuring the file is synchronized to disk.
